    After the Rain

    Noa heard the first part of Owen’s comment. She was already worried about her photo, so she thought he didn’t like it. She moved the photo into a folder in the club’s backup and asked the editor to take the page out. The original photo was found in that folder.

    Owen’s full comment

    “I can’t believe Noa took that photo. It’s the best photo in the book.”

    Owen sent the old page layout to the printer. His name was still in the photo credit when the printer reused the layout.

    Noa’s reply

    “I thought you didn’t want my photo in the book. I want to put it back now.”
